source_selection.selection: Common4source macro informativecenter partialNLL; strict minimum, exacttie listed CONTROLLED_ONLY first. GPU validation is frozen selection criterion; later CPU audits cannot reselect.
limitations: Controlled cutouts and conditional photographic teachers are separate evidence tiers.
Current223 remains evaluation-only and repeatedly exposed development cohort.

source_conditional_precision_scope: All class/binary precision conditional on known native exact/radius2 GT. UNKNOWN is excluded from correctness metrics and separately retained in denominators/prediction counts.

definitions.exact: At floor(initialquery+.5), target-visible/full-support state; semantic reference D/E/S is separate.
definitions.radius2: Native clipped5x5 square around exact querypixel; any visible support / any full support, represented by correlated6joint. Not a pose update or coordinate correction.
definitions.binary_absent: p_visible_exact<0.5. It does not establish external/self cause or physical absence.
definitions.confidence_U: maxjoint<0.5; confidenceMAP pair held separate from primary binary. Unknown labels never padded to E/O.
definitions.source_full_only: Original BOP fullrender1/visible0 retains projected-model membership proxy but external cause is not independently certified; conservative fullUNKNOWN in v66 labels, originalproxy retained.
definitions.paired_teacher: SAM interior+supplied mesh/depth+paired visibility evidence conditional on alignment/static object. No human pixelgold; O/fullnegative and semantic self disabled.

data_scope.sourcephysical: Single pallet-bin physical instance with lab/hall environment holdout; not new-instance/flat-pallet validation.
data_scope.current223: Own wood105+square118; no public322 SHA overlap, direct user provenance confirmation. Repeatedly exposed development cohort, not fresh final holdout.

source_boundary_failure_diagnosis.interpretation: Source strict25-visible preservation regressed as well as boundary performance; boundary-only or current-only semantic target mismatch cannot explain all regression. RawSAM positive among strictV falseabsences is retained as a diagnostic, not final causal proof.

next_step: Verify source-only visible-preservation failure mechanisms using frozen outputs; do not change radius/threshold to fit current evaluation and do not start new training.
